Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:
 Vertical Rotary Regenerative Air Heater Ljungstrom
 C-E Air Preheater
 Company USA
Introduction

This 
 document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must performed every two 
 months as indicated by M2 in the title block.
The Ljungstrom air heater absorbs waste heat from flue gases, then transfers this heat to incoming cold air to increase the temperature of the incoming combustion or air process.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Emad El din Ali Elbana, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by EDEPCo. inspection & quality control 
at eng Samir Abd El- Gelil, Approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif; head 
Sector of 
Abu Soltan Power Station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al 
Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.
Technical Specification
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Feeler, gauge, Hammer
Suitable lifting device, Manual puller, Torque wrench

sections.text:
Work to be Carried 
Out

Before 
Isolating the Air Heater Mechanically and Electrically

items:
Check any abnormal 
 noise or vibration.

Check any air or flue 
 gases leakage from manholes.

Check the oil 
 level of upper guide bearing.

Check the oil 
 level of lower support bearing.

Check the oil 
 level of drive unit.

Check the 
 temperature of the upper and lower bearing, temp. should be ≤ 50

Check the oil 
 level of drive unit for blowing equipment.

Check 
 auxiliary drive in service for a few minutes

sections.text:
After 
Isolating the Air Heater Mechanically and Electrically

items:
Vent the water cooling system for Guide 
 Bearing in the top end and clean it if needed.

Check sealing clearance according to 
 table No. 1 and figure No. 6
Check alignment limits for coupling.

Limits for Coupling
Return Regenerative Air Heater into Service

items:
Operate the 
 regenerative air heater by coordination with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the
 regenerative air heater is 
 OK and record the readings of clearance, temp., vibration, ... etc, and 
 compare with ref. values.
